sentences.text: 5. The FIR of the matter was lodged on 8.9.2021 by Ram Prakash Gupta against the applicant alleging therein that his daughter aged about 15 years used to be tortured while going to school by the applicant.
Since last one year, the applicant used to throw a plain paper in front of his daughter after writing his phone number on the said paper.
He used to call on the phone of his wife and threaten his daughter.
After threatening the victim, the applicant committed rape upon her 4-5 times.
He then again called on the mobile of his wife and told his daughter to talk easily otherwise he would defame her.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is argued that in so far as the place of occurrence is concerned, there is no mention in the FIR as to what is the place of occurrence.
While placing site-plan which is annexure no.9 to the affidavit, it is argued that the Investigating Officer has very vaguely prepared the place of occurrence.
It is argued that the victim in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. has although supported the prosecution case but in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. there are contradictions in it.

It is argued that trial in the present matter has started in which first informant Ram Prakash Gupta has been examined as P.W.1 whereas the victim has been examined as P.W.2 and even therein the victim has stated that the applicant has exploited her physically 3-4 times and established physical relationship on the roof of her house.
She stated that the applicant used to force her to the extent that she had to come on roof.
It is argued that looking to the site-plan of the incident, it was just impossible for anyone to reach there except by going from inside the house.

While placing para 13 of the affidavit, it is argued that the Investigating Officer has not collected any call detail report of the mobile phone of the applicant or of the victim so as to do fair investigation.

While placing para 17 of the affidavit, it is argued that the reason of false implication of the applicant is that since the applicant and one Shyam Nandan Singh were collateral in the property and said Shyam Nandan Singh used to take money from the informant for the said property but Shyam Nandan Singh and informant could not succeed to get the said property, hence the applicant has been named in the FIR and has been falsely implicated.

It has also been pointed out that the applicant is not having any criminal history as stated in para 26 of the affidavit and is in jail since 9.9.2021.
7.
Per contra learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the first informant vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the victim as per FIR is aged about 15 years.
Even the C.M.O concerned in his report dated 13.9.2021 has opined the age of the victim to be 16 years.
The victim as per High School Certificate is having date of birth as 4.4.2006 and as such was aged about 15 years at the time of incident.
The applicant is named in the FIR, in the statements recorded under Section 161, 164 Cr.P.C. and there are allegations of rape against him.
It is argued that since there are allegations against the applicant and the victim is a minor girl, the bail application be rejected.

8. After hearing the counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is apparent that applicant is named in the FIR, in the statements recorded under Section 161, 164 Cr.P.C. of the victim Even the Vishal Singh vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: first informant and the victim have supported the prosecution case before the trial court.
The trial is going on in which two witnesses have been examined.
The release of the applicant at this stage may tamper the trial.
The victim is a minor girl.

In so far as the argument regarding site-plan, place of occurrence is concerned and entry in the house and person going to the roof is concerned, the same is material of trial which has to be appreciated after evidence with regards to the same.
9. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I do not find it a fit case for bail, hence, the bail application is rejected.
